# Secondary topic-disjoint endpoint after a schema-only preflight

All 482 problem strings were empty. No forecasts or scores were made in the problem-level protocol. A schema check found 167 nonempty distinct topic strings and a dialogue history for each pair. For this secondary evaluation, explicitly use normalized topic as the grouping and resampling unit. Exclude training topics, verbatim matching full normalized histories across training and the earlier MRBench development release (compare turn bodies without role markers), shared exact nonempty response texts, and duplicate unordered pairs within topic. Retain every other test row. This design assesses transfer to distinct topic strings with exact dialogue overlap checks. The absence of original problem IDs prevents verifying problem-level independence. Keep the frozen models, candidate, baselines, 10,000 draws, margin and multiplicity correction. The expert-role ceiling remains a separate information condition. No test outcomes informed this amendment.
